classification.difficultyReason: Calculate pyramid and cone volumes with different base-area formulas, recognise that the cone measurement is a diameter, and subtract the volumes.

content.prompt: What is the difference between the volumes of these two solids? Round your answer to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Square-based pyramid left and cone right, with matching perpendicular heights. Ordinary outlines are black and decorative face fills are omitted.
spec.mathematics: Pyramid square base has adjacent sides 3 cm and height 8 cm. Cone diameter is 3 cm and height is 8 cm. Preserve dashed hidden edges, dashed rear base arc, dimension arrows and cone centre marker.
spec.answerVisibility: All dimensions are permanent student-visible givens; no answers are drawn.
